title: Hypothyroidism impairs skeletal muscle regeneration after injury by altering myogenic and nonmyogenic pathways
comparison_or_design: The post-injury tibialis-anterior scRNA-seq comparison of thyroid status, retaining source-supported pooling and sample identities.
excluded: Fucci models, histology, cell-type-specific follow-up assays and reanalysis of cell expression/count matrices
